services.name: Safari Eco Sandbar Tour
services.desc: This Safari Eco tour is Key West’s best kept secret! 2.5 hours About Jump in and captain your very own private boat as your tour guide takes you through Key West’s back country on this one of a kind Key West eco excursion. Travel through the mangrove islands, past Bird Key, into the Mud Keys on your way to the local treasure, Snipes Point sandbar for a dip in the beautiful turquoise waters. Grab some snorkel gear and explore this mangrove island, known for its crystal clear waters and abundant wildlife. Come explore our secluded beaches and mangrove islands only accessible by boat. 2.5 Hours • All Ages • Captain a 2-person Pistol Boat!

services.name: Parrot Key Group Paddle
services.desc: Join us daily for a group eco-excursion to discover the diverse wildlife of Key West and take in the world-renowned Keys sunset. Choose from a paddleboard or kayak and the on-site watersports team from Sunset Watersports will give you expert instruction on our equipment to prepare you to embark on this exciting adventure. Keep your eyes peeled on this sunset tour to see Key West’s diverse wildlife including tropical birds, fish, and much more!
